title: Speed of Shadow Cast by a Streetlight
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A 6-ft person walks away from a 15-ft streetlight at 4 ft/s. How fast is the tip of the person's shadow moving along the ground?

steps.title: Set up Geometry via Similar Triangles
steps.explanation: Let x be the person's distance from the pole, and s be the distance from the pole to the tip of the shadow.
steps.why: Similar triangles formed by the light pole and the person.

steps.title: Cross-Multiply and Simplify the Relation
steps.explanation: Isolate shadow tip position s in terms of person position x.

steps.title: Differentiate with Respect to Time
steps.why: Rate of change of shadow tip.
